# Coin Peek (몰래코인)

> Free, open-source desktop widget for Windows and Mac that shows Binance (USDT), Upbit (KRW) and bitbank (JPY) cryptocurrency prices when you move the mouse to the screen edge. No account, no API key, no exchange connection. Current version: v0.1.4.

Coin Peek lives in the system tray (menu bar on Mac). Moving the cursor to the left or right screen edge slides in a panel with the watchlist: price, change, a 90-day daily chart, and profit and loss when an amount and average price are entered. Moving the cursor away hides it. It is the crypto sibling of Stock Peek (https://stock-peek.com).

Key facts:

- Platforms: Windows 10 and 11; macOS 12 or later (universal build)
- Price and license: free, MIT License
- Markets: Binance USDT market (search by ticker, ranked by 24-hour volume), Upbit KRW market (search by Korean or English name or ticker) and bitbank JPY market (search by ticker or Japanese name, ranked by trading volume)
- Price sources: Binance, Upbit and bitbank public market data APIs, called directly from the user's computer. Binance uses data-api.binance.vision first and api.binance.com as a fallback; bitbank uses public.bitbank.cc
- Change figure: Binance and bitbank are against 24 hours ago; Upbit is against the previous close (00:00 KST)
- Default watchlist on first launch follows the display language: Korean starts with Upbit, Japanese with bitbank, others with Binance
- Refresh: every 3 seconds, around the clock; one batched request per exchange
- Display: small-cap coins keep four significant digits (up to 8 decimals); holdings accept up to 8 decimals
- Languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Arabic (app and website)
- Data: watchlist, holdings and settings stay on the user's computer. Network requests are only for prices, update checks, and a once-a-day 1-byte download from GitHub used to count daily users (no data or identifier is sent). No analytics or advertising SDKs
- Corporate networks: uses the system proxy and certificates, but networks that block exchange sites will not show prices
- Installation warnings: the app is not code-signed. Windows SmartScreen shows a warning ("More info" → "Run anyway"). On Mac the first launch must be allowed in System Settings → Privacy & Security ("Open Anyway")
- Updates: checked at launch, hourly, when the panel opens, and from Settings. Windows installs after a notification click; Mac opens the download page
- Limitation: prices may be delayed and are not official trading data or investment advice

## Pages

- [Coin Peek — Desktop crypto price widget](https://coin-peek.com/en): A free Windows and Mac desktop widget: move the mouse to the screen edge to see prices and profit and loss for your Binance, Upbit and bitbank coins. Also in [한국어](https://coin-peek.com/), [日本語](https://coin-peek.com/ja), [العربية](https://coin-peek.com/ar).
- [Coin Peek guide](https://coin-peek.com/en/guide/): What Coin Peek is, how to install it, which Binance, Upbit and bitbank markets it covers, where prices come from, how change is measured, profit and loss, local storage and FAQ. Also in [한국어](https://coin-peek.com/guide/), [日本語](https://coin-peek.com/ja/guide/), [العربية](https://coin-peek.com/ar/guide/).
- [Coin Peek releases](https://coin-peek.com/en/releases/): The latest Coin Peek version for Windows and Mac, release notes, how updates work and system requirements. Also in [한국어](https://coin-peek.com/releases/), [日本語](https://coin-peek.com/ja/releases/), [العربية](https://coin-peek.com/ar/releases/).
- [Coin Peek privacy](https://coin-peek.com/en/privacy/): What Coin Peek stores on your computer and which network requests it makes for prices and updates. Also in [한국어](https://coin-peek.com/privacy/), [日本語](https://coin-peek.com/ja/privacy/), [العربية](https://coin-peek.com/ar/privacy/).
